items.details: This job unlocks only after Supply & Demand and Sir, Yes Sir!, followed by Kent Paul's call. Prepare armor and a strong vehicle before starting. Lance's health keeps falling while you approach the junkyard, so drive directly there instead of stopping to shop. Clear a path through the guards, reach the building at the far end and bring him to an escape vehicle. Once he is following you, prioritize the hospital journey over fighting every pursuing car. Do not leave without confirming he has entered your vehicle.

items.details: Bring Lance with you and lure two police officers into the marked garage; wait for both to enter before the doors close. After obtaining the uniforms, use a police car for the approach to North Point Mall. Keep your weapon lowered while moving through the disguised stage. Reach the cafe marker, plant the device and immediately leave the blast area with Lance. The return is under heavy police pressure, so use a sound vehicle and an escape route you know. details_i18n.pt: Leve Lance e atraia dois policiais à garagem marcada; espere os dois entrarem antes de as portas fecharem. Após obter os uniformes, use um carro policial para se aproximar do North Point Mall. Mantenha a arma abaixada na etapa de disfarce. Alcance a marcação do café, plante o dispositivo e saia imediatamente da área da explosão com Lance. O retorno ocorre sob forte pressão policial; use um veículo em bom estado e uma rota de fuga conhecida. Tanto sua sobrevivência quanto o retorno seguro de Lance importam.

items.details: Complete Cop Land so the Vercetti Estate earns money. Separately, activate six purchased businesses: Print Works is mandatory, plus any five of Malibu Club, Kaufman Cabs, Sunshine Autos, Boatyard, Cherry Popper, Pole Position and the film studio. Merely buying them is not enough: finish their tasks until income appears. Phil's Place does not count because it is not a revenue asset. Sunshine Autos qualifies after its first delivery list; all four lists and every business are needed for 100%, not this ending gate. If the next mission is absent, check completed income sources before buying more property.

If the next mission is absent, check completed income sources before buying more property.
details_i18n.pt: Conclua Cop Land para a mansão Vercetti gerar dinheiro. Apenas comprá-los não basta: termine suas tarefas até surgir a renda. Phil's Place não conta porque não é um negócio de renda. Sunshine Autos vale após a primeira lista de entregas; as quatro listas e todos os negócios são exigidos para 100%, não para esse bloqueio do final. Se a próxima missão não aparecer, confira as fontes de renda concluídas antes de comprar outras propriedades.

items.details: Begin with full health and armor and weapons suitable for both the corridor and the upper floors. Initially hold a position near the office and stop attackers reaching the safe. When the objective changes to the upstairs pursuit, follow it rather than staying indefinitely at the office; use cover during the rooftop fight. After that target is resolved, return downstairs for the final confrontation. Collect available health or armor between phases when safe, and avoid spending all your strongest ammunition on ordinary waves before the named targets appear.

details_i18n.en: Begin with full health and armor and weapons suitable for both the corridor and the upper floors. Initially hold a position near the office and stop attackers reaching the safe. When the objective changes to the upstairs pursuit, follow it rather than staying indefinitely at the office; use cover during the rooftop fight. After that target is resolved, return downstairs for the final confrontation. Collect available health or armor between phases when safe, and avoid spending all your strongest ammunition on ordinary waves before the named targets appear.
details_i18n.pt: Comece com saúde e colete completos e armas adequadas ao corredor e aos andares superiores. Inicialmente mantenha uma posição perto do escritório e impeça os atacantes de alcançar o cofre. Quando o objetivo mudar para a perseguição no andar de cima, siga-o em vez de permanecer indefinidamente no escritório; use cobertura no combate da cobertura. Após resolver esse alvo, volte ao andar inferior para o confronto final. Recolha saúde ou colete entre as fases quando for seguro e evite gastar toda a munição mais forte nas ondas comuns antes de surgirem os alvos nomeados.

items.details: The original PS2 timer is seven minutes and starts when the remote helicopter picks up its first bomb. Before collecting one, practice lift, descent, turning and the route through the building. Identify the stairwell and the four marked placement points so you can fly a planned sequence instead of searching while carrying a bomb. Keep the helicopter level near beams and stair edges; repeated collisions can destroy it. Take each bomb to a marked barrel position, release it precisely, then return for another. Do not assume the longer timer or remapped controls of later editions.

Before collecting one, practice lift, descent, turning and the route through the building. Identify the stairwell and the four marked placement points so you can fly a planned sequence instead of searching while carrying a bomb. Keep the helicopter level near beams and stair edges; repeated collisions can destroy it. Take each bomb to a marked barrel position, release it precisely, then return for another. Do not assume the longer timer or remapped controls of later editions.
details_i18n.pt: O cronômetro original de PS2 é de sete minutos e começa quando o helicóptero remoto pega a primeira bomba. Antes disso, pratique subida, descida, curvas e a rota pelo prédio. Identifique a escadaria e os quatro pontos de colocação para seguir uma sequência planejada, sem procurar enquanto carrega uma bomba. Mantenha o helicóptero nivelado perto das vigas e bordas das escadas; colisões repetidas podem destruí-lo. Leve cada bomba a um ponto marcado junto aos barris, solte-a com precisão e volte para buscar outra. Não pressuponha o prazo maior nem os controles remapeados das versões posteriores.

items.details: This Cuban finale needs both Naval Engagement and Auntie Poulet's Dirty Lickin's finished. Use the requested Voodoo to enter the factory operation and keep the group together through the entry. Once inside, clear nearby defenders before planting the devices so you are not searching for an exit under fire. After the final plant, the obvious front exit is blocked; use the stairs and elevated escape route around the side of the compound. Keep moving until the mission confirms you are outside the blast area.

details_i18n.en: This Cuban finale needs both Naval Engagement and Auntie Poulet's Dirty Lickin's finished. Use the requested Voodoo to enter the factory operation and keep the group together through the entry. Once inside, clear nearby defenders before planting the devices so you are not searching for an exit under fire. After the final plant, the obvious front exit is blocked; use the stairs and elevated escape route around the side of the compound. details_i18n.pt: Este final da sequência cubana exige concluir Naval Engagement e Dirty Lickin's, de Auntie Poulet. Use o Voodoo solicitado para entrar na operação da fábrica e mantenha o grupo junto durante a entrada. Lá dentro, elimine defensores próximos antes de plantar os dispositivos para não procurar a saída sob fogo. Após plantar o último, a saída frontal mais óbvia fica bloqueada; use as escadas e a rota elevada de fuga pela lateral do pátio. Continue avançando até a missão confirmar que você saiu da área da explosão.

items.details: Do not leave the limousine while the bomb is active. The detonation meter rises when you slow too much and falls when you keep moving fast enough, so choose wide roads with gentle turns instead of narrow alleys. You do not need maximum speed: controlled movement prevents crashes that would stop the car. Watch the meter during corners and keep going while the band works on the device. Only after the game confirms the bomb is disarmed should you follow the normal final drop-off instruction.

details_i18n.en: Do not leave the limousine while the bomb is active. The detonation meter rises when you slow too much and falls when you keep moving fast enough, so choose wide roads with gentle turns instead of narrow alleys. You do not need maximum speed: controlled movement prevents crashes that would stop the car. Watch the meter during corners and keep going while the band works on the device. Only after the game confirms the bomb is disarmed should you follow the normal final drop-off instruction.
details_i18n.pt: Não saia da limusine enquanto a bomba estiver ativa. O medidor de detonação sobe quando você reduz demais e cai quando mantém velocidade suficiente; escolha vias largas com curvas suaves em vez de becos. Não é preciso velocidade máxima: condução controlada evita colisões que parariam o carro. Observe o medidor nas curvas e continue rodando enquanto a banda trabalha no dispositivo. Somente após o jogo confirmar que a bomba foi desarmada siga a instrução normal da entrega final.

items.details: You begin in a Sentinel while Hilary has the quicker Sabre Turbo. Learn the checkpoint sequence and brake before tight corners rather than trying to win through straight-line speed. Stay close enough to exploit traffic or a wide turn, and protect your own car from a damaging collision. Police interference is part of the race, so leave space to dodge road traffic and patrols. A lost early lead is not necessarily the end: prioritize clean checkpoint lines and wait for a safe passing opportunity instead of repeatedly ramming from behind.

details_i18n.pt: Você começa em um Sentinel, enquanto Hilary usa o Sabre Turbo mais rápido. Mantenha proximidade para aproveitar o trânsito ou uma curva aberta e proteja seu carro de colisões fortes. A interferência policial faz parte da corrida; deixe espaço para desviar do trânsito e das patrulhas. Perder a liderança no início não encerra necessariamente a tentativa: priorize trajetórias limpas nos checkpoints e espere uma ultrapassagem segura em vez de bater repetidamente por trás.

items.details: Take the Skimmer behind the studio and allow a straight stretch of water for takeoff. Pass through a blue checkpoint to begin dropping flyers, then head for the red endpoint that appears; the remaining blue markers return afterward. Repeat each blue-to-red segment rather than searching for all blue markers while a drop is already active. Use broad turns with enough altitude to avoid buildings and keep the plane level through markers. Watch the fuel supply and plan the next turn before you reach a checkpoint.

details_i18n.pt: Pegue o Skimmer atrás do estúdio e use um trecho reto de água para decolar. Repita cada trecho azul-vermelho, em vez de procurar todos os azuis enquanto um lançamento já está ativo. Faça curvas amplas com altitude suficiente para evitar os prédios e mantenha o avião nivelado nos checkpoints. Observe o combustível e planeje a curva seguinte antes de alcançar cada ponto.

items.details: Take the PCJ-600 to the office building and use the indicated stairs and lift to reach the upper office. The route begins by breaking through the window toward the first rooftop marker. Approach ramps straight and avoid correcting sharply in midair; a controlled landing preserves the bike for the next gap. If you fall, use the available access route back up instead of searching the street directly beneath a marker. Continue through the rooftop checkpoints before the displayed morning deadline, then dismount at the final spotlight objective.

items.details: The first original PS2 course has twenty-six checkpoints and a two-minute-thirty-second limit. Enter either available boat and learn its handling before trying to maximize speed. On the jump sequence, align the hull squarely with the ramps; a fast diagonal approach can miss the next platform and cost more time than cautious steering. Ease off the throttle briefly for alignment, then accelerate through clear stretches. The first successful course activates the Boatyard for the story asset count; repeated harder courses are not required to turn it into an income source.

details_i18n.en: The first original PS2 course has twenty-six checkpoints and a two-minute-thirty-second limit. Enter either available boat and learn its handling before trying to maximize speed. details_i18n.pt: O primeiro percurso original de PS2 tem vinte e seis checkpoints e limite de dois minutos e trinta segundos. Entre em um dos barcos disponíveis e aprenda sua condução antes de tentar velocidade máxima. Na sequência de saltos, alinhe o casco de frente com as rampas; uma aproximação diagonal rápida pode errar a próxima plataforma e custar mais tempo que dirigir com cuidado. Solte brevemente o acelerador para alinhar e acelere nos trechos livres. A primeira conclusão ativa o Boatyard na contagem de negócios da história; repetir percursos mais difíceis não é necessário para gerar renda.

items.details: Use the factory Mr. Whoopee and complete fifty sales during one active Distribution run. Stop near customers with the sales music playing, move when an area has no customers and drive away briefly when police pressure rises. Do not get out, become arrested or lose the van before fifty; separate short attempts do not combine for asset completion. After fifty, end the activity and check the factory income. Early original PS2 releases have a documented Cherry Popper save-point corruption problem: use another property's save point and preserve a recovery slot rather than saving at this factory.

details_i18n.pt: Use o Mr. Whoopee da fábrica e conclua cinquenta vendas em uma única tentativa ativa de Distribution. Não desça, seja preso nem perca o furgão antes das cinquenta; tentativas curtas separadas não se somam para concluir o negócio. Após cinquenta, encerre a atividade e confira a renda da fábrica. As primeiras edições originais de PS2 têm um problema documentado de corrupção no salvamento de Cherry Popper: salve em outra propriedade e preserve um espaço de recuperação.

description_i18n.en: Return to the Downtown Ammu-Nation challenge after The Shootist; the earlier recruitment score alone is not enough for this goal.
description_i18n.pt: Volte ao desafio da Ammu-Nation de Downtown após The Shootist; a pontuação anterior do recrutamento sozinha não basta para esta meta.

items.details: The recruitment mission The Shootist and the later Rifle Range challenge are distinct checks. After completing The Shootist, return to Downtown Ammu-Nation and start the repeatable range activity. Score at least forty-five in that challenge, not merely a passing recruitment total spread across its earlier rounds. Concentrate on the farther targets because a complete distant target is worth more than a nearby one. Avoid leaving obstructing fragments in front of the targets you intend to finish, and verify the recorded score afterward.

details_i18n.pt: A missão de recrutamento The Shootist e o desafio posterior Rifle Range são verificações distintas. Após The Shootist, volte à Ammu-Nation de Downtown e inicie a atividade repetível do estande. Marque pelo menos quarenta e cinco nesse desafio, não apenas um total suficiente no recrutamento distribuído entre as rodadas anteriores. Priorize os alvos mais distantes, pois um alvo completo ao fundo vale mais que um próximo. Evite deixar fragmentos bloqueando os alvos que pretende terminar e confira a pontuação registrada depois.

items.details: Complete levels one through twelve without ending the activity. The ambulance holds three patients, so plan each level as several efficient hospital trips once more than three are waiting. Brake early near patients and avoid collisions that damage the vehicle or waste the timer. Do not leave the ambulance or run over a patient. Use the hospital approach you know best and save before committing to the long attempt. Vice City does not use GTA III's per-island Vigilante and Firefighter totals; check each service's own level goal.

details_i18n.pt: Conclua os níveis de um a doze sem encerrar a atividade. A ambulância leva três pacientes; quando houver mais de três esperando, planeje viagens eficientes ao hospital. Freie cedo perto dos pacientes e evite colisões que danifiquem o veículo ou desperdicem o cronômetro. Não saia da ambulância nem atropele um paciente. Use o acesso ao hospital que conhecer melhor e salve antes da tentativa longa. Vice City não usa os totais de Vigilante e Firefighter por ilha de GTA III; confira a meta de nível própria de cada serviço.

items.details: Use a Pizza Boy parked at a pizza restaurant to begin the delivery activity. You can carry six pizzas at a time, so later levels require returning to the restaurant for a refill before serving every customer. Plan nearby deliveries together and keep the remaining stock in mind. Ride close enough to the marked customer and use the sideways delivery action rather than getting off to hand it over. Finish level ten in the same active run. Taxi fares are cumulative, but this level-based pizza goal is not.

details_i18n.pt: Use uma Pizza Boy estacionada em uma pizzaria para iniciar as entregas. Você leva seis pizzas por vez; nos níveis posteriores precisa voltar ao restaurante para reabastecer antes de atender todos. Planeje entregas próximas em conjunto e acompanhe o estoque restante. Passe perto o suficiente do cliente marcado e use o comando de entrega lateral, em vez de descer para entregar. Termine o nível dez na mesma tentativa ativa. As corridas de táxi são cumulativas, mas essa meta de pizzas por níveis não é.
